newsitem.title: UK: Candover sells ERC to SAirGroup.
newsitem.headline: Candover sells ERC to SAirGroup.

text.p: Buy-out specialist Candover Investments Plc said on Tuesday it had sold European Rail Catering (ERC), formerly British Rail's catering division, to Rail Gourmet for an undisclosed amount.
Candover provided 1.5 million stg of equity capital and the Candover 1994 fund 5.5 million, with the remaining equity provided by management.
Rail Gourmet is the rail catering unit of SAirRelations, the holding company for non-flight operations of SAirGroup, the parent of Swissair.
ERC supplies catering products to the rail industry and has an annual turnover of 40 million stg.
